evals.prompt: Our app has 9 top-level tabs on iPhone and Android: Home, Portfolio, Trade, Crypto, eBanking, Cards, Documents, Offers, Settings. Users complain they can't find their tax documents. Propose a new structure.
evals.expected_output: A proposal with an inventory and top tasks, a reduced top level (iOS tab bar and Android navigation bar with 3-5 destinations), a tree placing tax documents under a predictable path with user vocabulary, a label glossary, and a tree test plan with success thresholds; the proposal is labelled as an assumption until tested.
assertions: Android top-level destinations are between 3 and 5
iPhone tab bar has 5 or fewer tabs or explicitly handles overflow
A tree test plan with pre-set thresholds is included
The proposed tree is labelled as an assumption until validated
